name: Exercise Taxonomy Crosswalk 2026 (free-exercise-db, wger, ExerciseDB v1 to HealthKit and Health Connect)
methodology: Every category, equipment, muscle and body-part term three open exercise databases publish, read up to 2026-11-05: free-exercise-db's JSON Schema enums, the wger REST API v2 lists, and the ExerciseDB v1 open API lists, each term spelled as its source spells it. Plus the 6 of free-exercise-db's 876 exercise names that share a key with a constant. Set against HealthKit's HKWorkoutActivityType cases and Health Connect's ExerciseSessionRecord and ExerciseSegment constants from this site's workout-types crosswalk. A term is mapped only when it is a database category or an exercise name and its key equals a constant's key; key = the name lowercased with a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ or EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_ removed and every character outside a-z0-9 removed. Equipment, muscle and body-part terms name no activity and are never mapped. nameContains lists constants whose words contain the term's words in order: a text coincidence shown for browsing, not a mapping. The databases' own licenses apply to their content (free-exercise-db: Unlicense (public domain); wger: Exercise data under Creative Commons licenses set per entry; code AGPL-3.0-or-later; ExerciseDB v1: Repository LICENSE is AGPL-3.0; no separate data license found); this dataset republishes only the term names and the derived match columns.
generatedFrom: src/data/exerciseTaxonomy.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-exercise-taxonomy.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.facet: category, equipment, muscle, body-part, or exercise (an exercise name that matched)
fields.term: The term exactly as the database spells it
fields.databaseId: wger's numeric id; null where the database gives none
fields.englishName: wger's English name for a muscle; null where it gives none
fields.key: DERIVED: lowercased, a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ or EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_ removed, characters outside a-z0-9 removed
fields.status: DERIVED: mapped when a category or exercise name has the same key as a constant; otherwise unmapped
fields.healthkit: DERIVED: HKWorkoutActivityType cases with the same key (mapped rows only)
fields.healthConnect: DERIVED: ExerciseSessionRecord.EXERCISE_TYPE_* constants with the same key
fields.healthConnectSegment: DERIVED: ExerciseSegment.EXERCISE_SEGMENT_TYPE_* constants with the same key
fields.nameContainsHealthkit: DERIVED: HealthKit cases whose name contains the term as whole words. A text coincidence, not a mapping
fields.nameContainsHealthConnect: DERIVED: Health Connect exercise types whose name contains the term as whole words. Not a mapping
fields.nameContainsSegment: DERIVED: Health Connect segment types whose name contains the term as whole words. Not a mapping
fields.reason: Why the row is mapped or unmapped
fields.source: The source the term was read from
